name: Clozapine
mechanism: Multiple receptor antagonism (D2, D4, 5-HT2A, muscarinic, α-adrenergic)
dosing: Start 12.5mg OD-BD, titrate slowly to 200-450mg daily (max 900mg). Requires registration
contraindications: Bone marrow disorders, severe cardiac disease, uncontrolled epilepsy, paralytic ileus
interactions: CNS depressants, drugs causing agranulocytosis, CYP1A2 inhibitors (↑ levels)
monitoring: MANDATORY FBC monitoring (weekly for 18 weeks, then fortnightly to 52 weeks, then monthly). ECG, weight, glucose, lipids
pregnancy: Avoid unless absolutely essential - specialist advice required
sideEffects: Agranulocytosis (1%), myocarditis, sedation, hypersalivation, seizures, weight gain, constipation
pharmacokinetics: Hepatic metabolism, half-life 12h, steady state 7-10 days
clinicalPearls: Treatment-resistant schizophrenia only. Clozapine Monitoring Service mandatory. Most effective antipsychotic but highest risk
indication: Treatment-resistant schizophrenia (failed ≥2 antipsychotics), psychosis in Parkinsons disease (specialist use)
